bot.start.title:
Welcome to the AI Agent 🤖
Connect AI providers, browse models, and use them from Telegram.
bot.help:
Commands: /start /help /settings /providers /models
Add a provider, select a model, then open a new chat. Use /cancel to cancel input.
common.soon: This feature will be available in a later stage.
provider.name: Send the provider name
provider.token: Send the API token in this private chat. I will attempt to delete your message after receiving it.
provider.headers.ask: Does this provider need additional headers?
provider.headers.input: Send headers as a JSON object. They will not be displayed after saving.
provider.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this provider?
chat.ready: Send a message. Each message is sent independently to the active model. Provider charges may apply.
model.test.warning: A small test will be sent to the provider and may incur a charge. Continue?
error.OFFLINE: Could not connect to the provider.
error.AUTH_FAILED: The key is invalid or lacks permission.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Rate limit reached. Try again later.
error.INVALID_RESPONSE: Could not interpret the provider response.
error.UNSUPPORTED: Automatic model discovery is unavailable or the operation is unsupported.
error.INVALID_URL: Invalid URL or blocked network destination.
error.NOT_FOUND: The item does not exist or you do not have access.
error.DISABLED: The provider is disabled or the model is no longer available.
error.NO_ACTIVE_MODEL: Select an active model from the model menu first.
error.INTERNAL: Could not complete the operation. Try again later.
files.prompt: Send a file or project archive as a document. Content is never executed automatically.
project.search_prompt: Send the text to search for.
project.question_prompt: Write your question about the project.
project.delete_confirm: Delete this project workspace and its files?
error.PATH_DENIED: Path access denied for security reasons.
error.EXTRACTED_TOO_LARGE: Extracted size exceeds the safe limit.
error.FILE_TOO_LARGE: File exceeds the safe size limit.
error.TOO_MANY_FILES: The project contains too many files.
error.INVALID_ARCHIVE: Could not safely read the archive.
error.INVALID_DOCUMENT: Invalid document or document safety limit exceeded.
error.BINARY_FILE: This file cannot be displayed as text.
agent.choose_mode: Choose agent mode: analyze, propose a diff, or apply workspace edits. Commands require approval.
agent.task_prompt: Describe the task for this project.
agent.restore_confirm: Restore all files in change {ident}? Files changed since application cannot be restored.
error.INVALID_PLAN: The model returned an invalid plan.
error.STALE_FILE: File or change state is stale. Create a new proposal.
error.INVALID_PATCH: Patch is invalid or does not match.
error.VALIDATION_FAILED: Validation failed. Review diff and test results.
error.SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE: Isolated validation unavailable. The command was not run on the host.
error.WORKER_INTERRUPTED: Worker interrupted. Review state before retrying.
error.COMMAND_DENIED: Validation command is not allowed for this project.
agent.verification: File/syntax checks completed. Tests: {tests}. Review the diff against your goal.
github.installation_prompt: Enter the GitHub App installation ID. Sign-in will verify your access to that installation.
github.token_prompt: Send a fine-grained PAT scoped to the required repositories and minimum permissions. The message is deleted best effort; the token is encrypted.
github.search_prompt: Enter part of the repository name.
github.publish_info: Publish task changes on its agent branch. Validation/secret checks and separate action approvals are required.
github.commit_prompt: Enter a short commit message. Exact files will be shown for approval.
github.pr_body_prompt: Enter the PR description with changes, validation and risks. It is created as a draft after approval.
mcp.url_prompt: Enter an HTTPS Streamable HTTP URL. User stdio commands and internal addresses are denied.
mcp.scope_prompt: Enter space-separated scopes to grant, or - for no additional scopes. The provider will display them for consent; scopes never expand automatically.
mcp.review_notice: New tools are disabled. Enabling requires a reviewed policy matching server identity and schema/description fingerprint. Dangerous tools are denied.
integration.open: Open this private link to finish connecting, then return to the bot. The link is short-lived and single-use; do not share it.
integration.confirm: Confirm this action on the selected connection?
mcp.prompt_arguments: Enter prompt arguments as a JSON object. Required parameters are shown below.
error.REPOSITORY_UNAUTHORIZED: Connection is not authorized for this repository.
error.INVALID_CREDENTIAL: Invalid credential; use a fine-grained PAT.
error.TOO_MANY_REPOSITORIES: Repository count exceeds the configured limit.
error.PROTECTED_BRANCH: Branch write denied. Use the task agent branch.
error.STALE_REPOSITORY: Remote base changed. Import a fresh workspace and review conflicts.
error.BRANCH_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Workspace branch belongs to another task; import a fresh copy for a new task.
error.DIRTY_REPOSITORY: Repository state changed or has unapproved files.
error.WRONG_BRANCH: Current branch does not match the task.
error.UNEXPECTED_FILES: Changed files differ from expected files.
error.VALIDATION_REQUIRED: A successful validation of the current files is required.
error.PUSH_REQUIRED: Push the approved commit before creating a PR.
error.REPOSITORY_SECRET_OR_ARTIFACT: Suspected secret or oversized/generated artifact found. Remove it before publishing; the secret is not displayed.
error.GIT_UNAVAILABLE: Git is unavailable in this runtime.
error.OAUTH_UNCONFIGURED: HTTPS callback URL is not configured.
error.OAUTH_CLIENT_UNCONFIGURED: OAuth client ID for this issuer is not configured.
error.OAUTH_STATE_INVALID: OAuth state is invalid, expired or used.
error.OAUTH_SCOPE_ESCALATION: Scope escalation or invalid token response denied.
error.SCOPE_REQUIRED: This tool needs an additional scope. Grant it explicitly from authorization settings.
error.AUTH_REQUIRED: Server requires OAuth or token authentication.
error.TRANSPORT_DENIED: Transport denied; use HTTPS Streamable HTTP.
error.INVALID_SCHEMA: Tool schema is invalid or unsupported.
error.MCP_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Tool requires a new reviewed fingerprint policy.
error.DATABASE_WRITE_DENIED: Database tools support structured reads only; arbitrary SQL and writes are denied.
error.WORKFLOW_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The operator must first review workflows and confirm agent branches cannot trigger production deployments.
error.WORKFLOW_WRITE_DENIED: Publishing changes to GitHub workflows is blocked.
mcp.token_prompt: Send the service token in this private chat. The message is deleted when possible and the token encrypted. Use a narrowly scoped token.
